Synthetic audio fixtures created for mvmAudio tests: one second of a generated
440 Hz sine wave at 48 kHz, encoded in several containers/codecs. No recordings,
commercial music or external samples are included. These test fixtures may be
used, copied and redistributed without restriction.

recorder.webm has no declared Duration and uses multiple clusters, to exercise
browser-style recordings. video-only.m4a and video-only.webm are generated black
16x16 frames with no audio and must be rejected.

Fixtures were encoded once during development. Running the test suite does not
require or invoke an encoder, decoder, FFmpeg, ffprobe, pip or network access.
